channel.title: UAE Free Zone AI Watch
channel.description: AI deals, adoption and launches announced by UAE free zones - competitor watch for DMCC

item.title: [Masdar City Free Zone] US-based Brain Digits opens office in Masdar City to build AI solutions for the UAE and GCC
item.description:
The office will develop AI solutions for the UAE market as Abu Dhabi pushes to become an AI-native government.
DMCC angle: Abu Dhabi's AI-native government agenda is pulling AI vendors into Abu Dhabi zones.

item.title: [DIEZ (DSO / DAFZ / Dubai CommerCity)] RTA opens Dubai Mobility Labs at Dubai Silicon Oasis with 248 autonomous-vehicle test scenarios
item.description:
A testing and certification facility for autonomous mobility in Dubai Silicon Oasis, combining controlled scenarios with public-road trials; DEKRA operates it for three years.
DMCC angle: DIEZ is anchoring physical-AI and autonomy infrastructure in its zones.

item.title: [TECOM (DIC / DMC / DSP / d3 / DKP)] SAP and Dubai Internet City convene women leaders on building the UAE's AI-ready workforce
item.description:
An executive panel and youth circle at Dubai Internet City on AI and women's careers in technology, part of Emirati Women's Day.
DMCC angle: TECOM uses anchor tenants (SAP) to run AI talent events - low-cost visibility.

item.title: [DIFC] 'SHE Leads with AI': Dubai AI Campus launches its first female-founder accelerator at DIFC Innovation Hub
item.description:
A six-day programme with fully funded places for 30 women founders, delivered at DIFC Innovation Hub with an investor showcase; it starts 16 November 2026.
DMCC angle: Dubai AI Campus keeps adding targeted founder programmes that widen DIFC's AI talent funnel.

item.title: [ADGM] ADGM completes phase one of in-house AI rollout: 25 business functions, 5,000+ staff hours saved a year, AED 400m roadmap to 2029
item.description:
ADGM deployed AI across licensing, supervision and customer service; about 25% of customer enquiries are now resolved instantly, and it will invest more than AED 400m in AI, data and cyber capabilities to 2029.
DMCC angle: ADGM can now show measured, member-facing AI results. DMCC members will compare service speed directly.

item.title: [ADGM] ADGM Academy launches WMI School of AI, training 544 UAE Nationals in agentic AI
item.description:
Part of ADGM Academy's H1 2026 output of 1,607 Emiratis trained; the agentic-AI school targets the wealth-management sector.
DMCC angle: Sector-specific AI skills programmes with published numbers are becoming standard for leading zones.

item.title: [ADGM] ADGM entities now hold more than USD 100bn in AI-focused investment, anchored by FSRA-licensed MGX
item.description:
ADGM positions itself as the jurisdiction of choice for institutions deploying capital into AI, alongside 54% AUM growth in H1 2026.
DMCC angle: Abu Dhabi is cornering AI capital; DMCC's angle is more naturally AI applied to trade and commodities.

item.title: [Sharjah zones (SRTIP / SPC / SAIF / Shams)] Shams AI Club trains 300+ professionals from 16 government entities; programmes run to end of October
item.description:
The first phase targets 500 participants with training on prompt engineering, automation, data analysis and responsible AI.
DMCC angle: Even media free zones run structured AI-skills programmes with public targets.

item.title: [DIFC] DIFC sets ambition to become the world's first AI-Native financial centre; AI, FinTech and innovation firms up 39% to 1,933
item.description:
In its H1 2026 results DIFC said AI will be embedded across its regulation, operations, talent and infrastructure, a transformation it expects to generate USD 3.5bn in economic value and 25,000 jobs; its Innovation Hub added 361 firms in H1.
DMCC angle: DIFC has turned AI into a whole-of-centre brand promise with hard targets - the benchmark any DMCC AI positioning will be compared against.

item.title: [RAK Innovation City (ex-RAK DAO)] UK PC maker Chillblast sets up GCC base in Innovation City Ras Al Khaimah for AI and gaming systems
item.description:
Chillblast's high-performance AI and gaming systems will be supported from its new regional base in Innovation City.
DMCC angle: Innovation City is converting its AI-and-gaming positioning into named company wins - DMCC also courts gaming firms.

item.title: [RAK Innovation City (ex-RAK DAO)] Innovation City (RAK) and Siada launch the Middle East's first sovereign AI data centre with NVIDIA B200 GPUs
item.description:
Licensed companies can rent sovereign GPU compute by the hour, reserve capacity or run fully managed environments, with data kept in the UAE.
DMCC angle: A small zone is competing on compute access, not licence price - a lever DMCC could match through partnerships.

item.title: [DIFC] DIFC launches consultation on amended Data Protection Regulations with new AI-related safeguards
item.description:
Proposed amendments strengthen governance and accountability for systems that process personal data, with specific safeguards for AI-driven processing.
DMCC angle: Regulatory clarity on AI and data is becoming a selling point for AI firms choosing a free zone.

item.title: [DIFC] DIFC Future of Finance report: AI-driven challenger banks reshape the industry; banks risk losing USD 170bn in profits by 2030
item.description:
DIFC's research report argues banks must adopt AI-led operating models or lose up to USD 170bn in profits by 2030.
DMCC angle: DIFC pairs its AI strategy with sector research - a playbook DMCC already uses with its Future of Trade report.

item.title: [Hub71, ADGM] Emirati founders unveil AI-powered solutions at Hub71 Impact 2026
item.description:
Hub71's showcase featured Emirati start-ups applying AI in marketing, healthcare and advanced manufacturing.
DMCC angle: Hub71 keeps a visible pipeline of AI founders - useful context for DMCC's start-up programmes.

item.title: [Hub71, ADGM] Mastercard Lighthouse and Hub71 open UAE AI start-up programme
item.description:
A four-month programme for start-ups using AI in financial services, commerce, risk and MSME solutions, run under the Mastercard UAE AI Center of Excellence with the UAE AI Office.
DMCC angle: Global corporates are co-running AI programmes inside competitor ecosystems.

item.title: [DIFC] Positron AI opens its first office outside the US in DIFC
item.description:
US AI-inference hardware maker Positron AI, which has raised more than USD 300m, chose DIFC for its first international office.
DMCC angle: AI infrastructure companies - not only AI software start-ups - are now being won by the financial centres.

item.title: [KEZAD / AD Ports] ROX signs lease for one of the Middle East's first advanced AI manufacturing centres in KEZAD Musaffah
item.description:
A 10,000 sqm intelligent manufacturing facility starting operations in H2 2026, targeting 300,000 vehicles a year by 2030.
DMCC angle: Industrial zones are attracting 'AI manufacturing' anchors - AI is spreading beyond tech and finance zones.
